projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A project is one model being customized. It starts from a model in the library and keeps every version trained from it.

reply.title: Reply settings
reply.intro: Every conversation in this project starts from these settings.
reply.instructionsHint: Text every conversation starts with, such as the model's role, its tone and the language to answer in. Optional.
reply.thinkingHint: The model writes out its reasoning before it replies. The reasoning can be read and edited.
reply.thinkingUnsupported: This base model doesn't write out its thinking.
reply.temperatureHint: Low values give steady replies. High values give more varied ones.
reply.topPHint: Low values keep to the most likely words. High values allow less common ones.
reply.maxTokensHint: Counted in tokens. A reply stops when it reaches this length.
reply.readOnly: Only a trainer or an administrator can change these settings.
